product_title: Handcrafted Red Rose Pearl Tealight Holder Set
product_description: Brighten your festive decor with this handcrafted set featuring rich red roses, elegant pearl borders, mirror embellishments, and golden detailing. Perfect for Diwali celebrations, pooja decor, and festive table styling.
product_care_suggestion: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid water and harsh cleaning chemicals.
Keep artificial flowers away from direct heat and open flames.
Use LED tealights for safer lighting around floral decorations.
Store in a dry, protective box when not in use.
